name: The Blueprint RequieM
source:
You take the role of a boy living with his family, in a small suburban, Ivory Island district.
Events begin to take a turn when you meet Laura’s boyfriend and his daughter (who would become your new stepsister) who are very close to a new church that recently opened in the district.
